table.retrieve:
SELECT
	RowID,
	Date,
	RegNo = (SELECT P.RegNo FROM Patient P WHERE P.PatientCode=SE.PatientCode),
	PatientName = (SELECT P.Name FROM Patient P WHERE P.PatientCode = SE.PatientCode),
	FHName = (SELECT P.FName FROM Patient P WHERE P.PatientCode = SE.PatientCode),
	Age = (SELECT LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(P.AgeYears))) + ' yrs ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(P.AgeMonths))) + ' mon ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(P.AgeDays))) + ' days ' FROM Patient P WHERE P.PatientCode = SE.PatientCode),
	Gender = (SELECT P.Gender FROM Patient P WHERE P.PatientCode = SE.PatientCode),
	PatientCode,
	AdmissionCode,
	CVSExam,
	PericardialRubExam,
	S3Exam,
	S4Exam,
	OSExam,
	OtherExam,
	ChestExaminationExam,
	BilateralNormalVesicularBreathingExam,
	BilateralCrepitationExam,
	RonchiExam,
	WheezingExam,
	RightBronchialBreathingExam,
	LeftBronchialBreathingExam,
	BilateralBronchialBreathingExam,
	AbsentAirEntryExam,
	PeripheralPulsesExaminationExam,
	PalpablebilaterallyinupperandlowerlimbExam,
	AbsentinLeftExam,
	RadialAbsentinLeftExam,
	UlnarAbsentinLeftExam,
	BrachialAbsentinLeftExam,
	AbsentinRightExam,
	RadialAbsentinRightExam,
	UlnarAbsentinRightExam,
	BrachialAbsentinRightExam,
	AbsentinLeft2Exam,
	FemoralAbsentinLeft2Exam,
	PoplitialAbsentinLeft2Exam,
	PosteriorTibbialAbsentinLeft2Exam,
	DorsalisPaedisAbsentinLeft2Exam,
	AbsentinRight2Exam,
	FemoralAbsentinRight2Exam,
	PoplitialAbsentinRight2Exam,
	PosteriorTibbialAbsentinRight2Exam,
	DorsalisPaedisAbsentinRight2Exam,
	OtherSystemicAbnormalFindingsExam,
	UserCode,
	AttendingDoctCode
FROM
	SE
WHERE 
	SE.AdmissionCode = :ai_code
ORDER BY
	SE.PatientCode,
	SE.RowID DESC
